hook.en: Tip a spoon of honey and a spoon of water together. Honey crawls because its layers resist sliding over each other. That internal friction is viscosity.
hook.kn: ಒಂದು ಚಮಚ ಜೇನು ಮತ್ತು ಒಂದು ಚಮಚ ನೀರನ್ನು ಒಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ಓರೆ ಮಾಡಿ. ಜೇನಿನ ಪದರಗಳು ಒಂದರ ಮೇಲೊಂದು ಜಾರಲು ಪ್ರತಿರೋಧಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ಈ ಆಂತರಿಕ ಘರ್ಷಣೆಯೇ ಸ್ನಿಗ್ಧತೆ.

body.en: Viscosity is the internal friction between layers of a fluid moving at different speeds. The viscous force is F = ηA(dv/dx), where η is the coefficient of viscosity. Its SI unit is the pascal second (N s m⁻²); 1 poise = 0.1 Pa s. The viscosity of liquids falls as temperature rises, while that of gases rises.
body.kn: ವಿಭಿನ್ನ ವೇಗದ ದ್ರವ ಪದರಗಳ ನಡುವಿನ ಆಂತರಿಕ ಘರ್ಷಣೆಯೇ ಸ್ನಿಗ್ಧತೆ. F = ηA(dv/dx). ಏಕಮಾನ Pa s. ತಾಪ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿದಾಗ ದ್ರವಗಳ ಸ್ನಿಗ್ಧತೆ ಕಡಿಮೆ, ಅನಿಲಗಳದು ಹೆಚ್ಚು.

points.en: Unit: Pa s; 1 poise = 0.1 Pa s

say.en: A liquid between a fixed plate and a moving plate flows in layers. The layer touching the moving plate moves with it; the bottom layer stays at rest.
The layers drag on each other. The viscous force is proportional to the area and to the velocity gradient.
Now drop a small sphere into a viscous liquid. Its weight acts down; buoyancy and viscous drag act up.
The drag grows with speed until the forces balance. Then the sphere falls at a steady terminal velocity.

say.en: A raindrop of radius 0.05 millimetre in air reaches only about 0.30 metres per second. Tiny drops in clouds float.
Speed against time rises and levels off at the terminal velocity.

narration.en: A liquid between a fixed plate and a moving plate flows in layers. The layer touching the moving plate moves with it; the bottom layer stays at rest. The layers drag on each other. The viscous force is proportional to the area and to the velocity gradient. Now drop a small sphere into a viscous liquid. Its weight acts down; buoyancy and viscous drag act up. The drag grows with speed until the forces balance. Then the sphere falls at a steady terminal velocity. A raindrop of radius 0.05 millimetre in air reaches only about 0.30 metres per second. Tiny drops in clouds float. Speed against time rises and levels off at the terminal velocity.

The viscous drag 6πηrv grows with speed until it balances weight minus buoyancy. From then on the ball falls at the terminal velocity v_t = 2r²(ρ − σ)g/(9η). Doubling the radius makes v_t four times larger.
narration.kn: ಸ್ನಿಗ್ಧ ಎಳೆತ 6πηrv ವೇಗದೊಂದಿಗೆ ಬೆಳೆದು ತೂಕ ಮೈನಸ್ ತೇಲುಬಲಕ್ಕೆ ಸಮವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಅಲ್ಲಿಂದ ಚೆಂಡು ಅಂತಿಮ ವೇಗ v_t = 2r²(ρ − σ)g/(9η) ನಲ್ಲಿ ಬೀಳುತ್ತದೆ. ತ್ರಿಜ್ಯ ಎರಡು ಪಟ್ಟಾದರೆ v_t ನಾಲ್ಕು ಪಟ್ಟು.

body.en: A small sphere of radius r moving slowly at speed v through a fluid feels a drag F = 6πηrv. A falling sphere speeds up until drag plus buoyancy balance its weight; it then falls at a steady terminal velocity v_t = 2r²(ρ − σ)g/(9η), where ρ is the density of the sphere and σ that of the fluid. Raindrops and dust settle this way.
body.kn: ಸ್ಟೋಕ್ಸ್ ನಿಯಮ: F = 6πηrv. ಬೀಳುವ ಗೋಳದ ತೂಕವನ್ನು ಎಳೆತ ಮತ್ತು ಉತ್ಪ್ಲಾವಕ ಬಲ ಸರಿದೂಗಿಸಿದಾಗ ಅದು ಸ್ಥಿರವಾದ ಅಂತಿಮ ವೇಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಬೀಳುತ್ತದೆ: v_t = 2r²(ρ − σ)g/(9η).
